From this collection we filter the cases where (a) the original query and the translated query are the same, or (b) more than 90% of the words from the query translation are not contained in the retrieved source title.
This leaves us with a dataset of 164,065 tuples of Spanish queries, English product titles and their Spanish translations (15% of the original collection).

In the second example, one of the tricky parts is to translate the sequence of nouns "Men Women Plastic Shoe Boxes" and to disambiguate the relations between them. The BL model translates "shoes of plastic", the Log has "woman of plastic" and the W-MIX model makes it "shoes of plastic" and "boxes of plastic". The W-MIX model learns to use "para" from the query, but omits the translation of "women".
